notes:
Release 1.2.0
- Fix(wakelock): Conditional wake lock now acquired only during active telemetry polling (when phone is charging). Released when screen off, not charging, or disconnected.
- Fix(ui): Re-added Orientation Lock toggle in Charger Screen & Display Settings card (PIID 20). Allows locking/unlocking charger LCD orientation.
- Fix(update): Version check now uses BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME instead of hardcoded value.
